import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskmod', file); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def sparse(h,w,bg,pts):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r,c),v in pts.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
